name: dp-it-prassi-grab
description: Downloads prassi PDFs into <dir>: Agenzia delle Entrate portal month pages (circolari, risoluzioni, provvedimenti) and MEF DocTrib interpelli. Sidecar files for the convert class.
author: open-lex-it

execute.description: For each item fetch its source and write atomically (ade: month page PDFs + sidecars; doctrib: search windows, detail pages, PDFs). dryRun: no request.

items.description: the items to download, as reported by the detect step

dryRun.description: plan only: no request, nothing written

output.description: { downloaded, skipped_existing, senza_pdf, mancanti, truncated, files: [...] }
